# Ramehead Freight - dispatch services

Every dispatch service starts from the block called `base` in `config/services.json`. A service block names the block it inherits from in its `inherits` field and then applies its own keys on top of what it inherits; keys it does not set keep the inherited value. Chains can run more than one step deep.

Ops keeps per-team notes under `docs/`.
files.docs/ops-notes.md:
# Ops notes

Tracking drivers' positions uses the poll loop only; position pushes to the control room go through the carrier's own channel. Booking holds are released by the finance sweep at night, not by a service setting.

If you cannot determine the answer, reply exactly UNKNOWN.
